description: Boston Dynamics' quadruped in the Robodex's 'Spot with Arm' configuration — the unit Abel photographed at the Cal Poly Pomona IRLab on 2026-10-28 (sighting spot-cpp). This spec is curated from Boston Dynamics' published figures, not from the photo draft: 1100 x 500 mm body, 840 mm standing height, 32.5 kg base mass (published base weight without the arm; the arm's mass is not in the published set, so no with-arm total is stated), 605 Wh pack. The manipulator is declared as an arms block on a quadruped drivetrain — the variant's defining feature, not a payload. Spec-derived from published figures — not a factory teardown, and not measured from the photographed unit.
name: Boston Dynamics Spot
